observations.title: Wells Pharmacy, Inc — 21 CFR 211.167(c) Controlled release dosage form testing

observations.source_summary: Each batch of controlled-release dosage form drug product is not laboratory tested to determine conformance to the specifications for the rate of release for each active ingredient.
